title: Regulatory Oversight and Compliance for Industrial Facilities
summary: This thread tracks the evolution of administrative requirements for industrial facilities seeking duty concessions. It shifts from a manual, inspection-heavy approval process to a more structured, document-based licensing and post-installation verification regime.

evolution.procedure: From ad-hoc physical inspection to standardized licensing and document-based verification.
evolution.institutions: Shifted from inter-departmental site verification to centralized licensing authority oversight.

timeline.change: Established a requirement for physical site verification by ICT and VAT officials for facility approval.
Introduced standardized licensing application forms and mandatory post-installation reporting requirements for machinery, shifting focus to document-based compliance.

National Board of Revenue: The Chairman of the National Board of Revenue is designated as the authority to receive applications from manufacturing or assembly industries seeking to import goods, parts, or raw materials under the concessional benefits provided by this order.
Manufacturing or Assembly Industry: Industries establishing a factory must apply to the National Board of Revenue to obtain approval for importing items under concessional duty benefits after the factory has been set up.
Information and Communication Technology: A representative from this division is required to participate in an on-site physical verification process to assess the eligibility of industrial applicants seeking concessional import benefits.
VAT Department: Relevant officers from the VAT department must conduct a physical inspection of the applicant's facility and, alongside other representatives, submit a formal report to the Chairman of the National Board of Revenue based on a specified template.

Bonded Warehouse License: To obtain a license, a person must submit an application in the prescribed form along with verified supporting documents, court fees, and other mandatory certificates. The application process requires the fulfillment of specific criteria such as facility size, operational history, and financial stability, as well as adherence to safety and legal standards. All accompanying documentation, including business registration and utility records, must be verified by the lien bank to ensure authenticity.
Value Added Tax: A valid Value Added Tax registration certificate is a mandatory requirement for applying for a bonded warehouse license.
Business Registration: Applicants must submit various registration documents, including trade licenses, fire licenses, and registration certificates from regulatory bodies like BoI or BSCIC, as part of the licensing process.
Industrial Raw Materials: The license application requires detailed documentation regarding raw materials, including commercial descriptions and HS codes, and mandates that storage facilities for these materials meet international quality standards.
Bonded Warehouse Operation: The operation of a bonded warehouse requires an applicant to demonstrate that the facility is physically secure with defined boundaries and adequate storage capacity. Licensees are required to comply with all domestic laws and regulations, providing a notarized affidavit as a formal commitment to this compliance.

৮। যন্ত্রপাতি স্থাপন ও সংযোজন।— (১) আমদানিকৃত অথবা স্থানীয়ভাবে সংগৃহীত যন্ত্রপাতি প্রতিষ্ঠানে স্থাপন করিবার ১৫ (পনেরো) কার্যদিবসের মধ্যে সংগৃহীত মেশিনের আমদানি বা ক্রয় সংক্রান্ত দলিলাদি, যথা বি/ই, এলসি, ইনভয়েস, বিএল/এয়ারওয়ে বিল/ট্রাক চালান, Bangladesh Export Processing Zones Authority (BEPZA) বা Bangladesh Economic Zones Authority (BEZA) কর্তৃক প্রদত্ত আইপি, মূসক চালানের কপি (প্রযোজ্য ক্ষেত্রে), মেশিন স্থাপন সংক্রান্ত ঘোষণা, মেশিনের ক্যাটালগ এবং স্থানীয়ভাবে ক্রয়কৃত/ আমদানিকৃত পুরাতন মেশিনের ক্ষেত্রে আয়ুষ্কাল, যাহা কমপক্ষে ১০ (দশ) বছর থাকিবার পক্ষে আন্তর্জাতিক খ্যাতিসম্পন্ন সার্ভেয়ার কোম্পানির আয়ুষ্কাল সনদসহ লাইসেন্সে সংযোজনের জন্য ডেপুটি কমিশনার অথবা অ্যাসিস্টেন্ট কমিশনার বরাবর আবেদন করিতে হইবে।
(২) রাজস্ব কর্মকর্তার নিম্নে নহি এমন কর্মকর্তা কর্তৃক কারখানা সরেজমিনে পরিদর্শন করিয়া দাখিলকৃত দলিলাদি মোতাবেক যন্ত্রপাতিসমূহ যথাযথভাবে প্রতিষ্ঠানে স্থাপন হইয়াছে কিনা তাহা নিশ্চিত হইয়া এবং প্রযোজ্য ক্ষেত্রে স্থাপিত যন্ত্রপাতির উৎপাদন ক্ষমতা নিরূপণপূর্বক দাখিলকৃত প্রতিবেদনের আলোকে লাইসেন্সিং কর্তৃপক্ষ তাহা সংযোজনের অনুমতি প্রদান করিবেন।

Bangladesh Export Processing Zones Autho: The authority issues investment permission documents required for the formal installation and inclusion of machinery into a licensed facility.
Bangladesh Economic Zones Authority: The authority issues investment permission documents required for the formal installation and inclusion of machinery into a licensed facility.
Licensing Authority: The authority is responsible for granting formal permission to include machinery in a license after verification of required documentation and physical inspection of the facility.
Customs Authority: Deputy or Assistant Commissioners are designated to receive applications for machinery installation, accompanied by relevant import or purchase documents and technical certifications. Revenue officers or higher-ranking officials are tasked with conducting physical inspections of the factory to verify that the machinery is correctly installed according to submitted documentation.
